links.comparator_used: Text only, numeric only, gradient number line and segmented number line formats for the same ML risk score
links.outcome: Perceived risk, trust in obstetrics team, intention to seek care, and format preference
links.effect: Inconsistent differences across formats in perceived risk, trust and behavioral intention; the gradient number line was the most preferred format (43%)
links.quote: There were main effects of risk level (all P < .001) such that participants perceived higher risk, were more likely to agree to treatment, and more trusting in their obstetrics team as the risk level increased, but we found inconsistencies in which presentation format corresponded to the highest perceived risk, trust, or behavioral intention.

design_hint: risk communication format for patient-facing ML risk scores
